name: Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026
summary: Seeks to increase the maximum strength of Lok Sabha from 550 to 850 seats and reverts to population-proportional seat allocation. Removes the freeze on delimitation based on the 1971 census.

name: Delimitation Bill, 2026
summary: Provides for a Delimitation Commission using the 2011 census. Empowers Central Government to constitute the Commission by Gazette notification.
keyProvisions: Commission: SC judge + CEC + State EC

name: Union Territories Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026
summary: Extends delimitation and women's reservation provisions to Puducherry, Delhi, and Jammu & Kashmir, mirroring the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill for states.
keyProvisions: Enables women's reservation in UT assemblies

name: Finance Bill, 2026
summary: Gives effect to the financial proposals for FY 2026–27. Nil-tax threshold raised to ₹12L, LTCG at 12.5%, customs duty cuts on electronics.

name: Appropriation Bill, 2026
summary: Authorises ₹50.65 lakh crore withdrawal from the Consolidated Fund for FY 2026–27.

name: Securities Markets Code, 2025
summary: Consolidates eight securities laws into a single code. Before Standing Committee on Finance for detailed scrutiny.

name: Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025
summary: Amends Waqf Act 1995, restructures Waqf Boards, introduces non-Muslim members, enhances oversight. Rajya Sabha sat until 4 AM.

name: Disaster Management (Amendment) Bill, 2024
summary: Gives statutory basis to NCMC, broadens definition of disasters to include pandemics, mandates state disaster funds.

name: G-RAM-G Bill, 2025
summary: Unified framework for gram sabha empowerment and rural asset mapping. Passed at 1 AM after opposition demanded select committee referral.

name: Banking Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2024
summary: Amends the RBI Act, Banking Regulation Act, and SBI Act to enhance governance at public sector banks.

name: Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2025
summary: Consolidates four foreigners laws into a single statute. Biometric registration and stricter entry penalties.

name: Bharatiya Vayuyan Vidheyak, 2024
summary: Replaces Aircraft Act 1934. Unified framework under DGCA, decriminalises violations, introduces drone provisions.

name: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025
summary: Draft rules under DPDP Act 2023. Consent management, data fiduciary obligations, children's data age verification.

name: Jan Vishwas (Amendment) Bill, 2024
summary: Second tranche of decriminalisation reforms. Converts imprisonment provisions in 22 additional laws into civil penalties. Under Joint Parliamentary Committee review.
